steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: So this is all the Londinium Citizens' Self-Salvation Corps men... who evacuated the city.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: We suffered greater losses than I imagined.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Some decided to stay. Even though the Sarkaz destroyed our stronghold, that doesn't mean they have a list of our collaborators.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We don't know exactly how bad the leak was, and a lot of our men think things aren't really that bad yet.

spans.text: We don't know exactly how bad the leak was, and a lot of our men think things aren't really

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Hmph, they still pretend they can go back to their quiet, peaceful lives.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Can't they see we have nowhere to run?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Don't say that, Rockrock. Most of them aren't fighters. They are just willing to place their hopes on us.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Most of the people who stand with us... aren't.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Soldiers who don't know who they should be loyal to, journalists who lost their jobs, workers sick of Sarkaz exploitation...

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Normal folk who have had enough.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: The Londinium Citizens' Self-Salvation Corps were formed by men like them.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: To leave Londinium... the place that we called home since we were born... is a lot more than delivering intel, forging a few weapons, and fighting the Sarkaz mercenaries...

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: It's to find where you belong in a real war with no end in sight and may end up dragging any number of people into actual turmoil. This is truly horrible.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: This is our Londinium. We should rely on no one but ourselves to defend it... That's what we used to think, at first.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: We thought we had been giving it our all to fight that horror...

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: But when it finally arrived... it turned out to be far more than we could actually bear.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: To tell the truth, I don't know what fate has in store for us from here onwards. We have some new friends now, but the enemy has now truly bared their fangs.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: We may soon find ourselves annihilated, become wandering ghosts that drift the wilderness, and in the end disperse all over...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Clovisia, stop being so gloomy.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: I came here only because I don't want to be handed a liberation by anyone.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: That's why we are all here.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: I'm a worker. I'm not one to talk about righteousness. All I know is that the workpieces I knock out are the most trustworthy.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: I want to save my city from those people hiding in the palaces and castles. I can't do it alone, but I found you.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: If we don't have what it takes together, we'll unite more people. If we still fail in the end...

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Then fine. I'll accept that outcome.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Hey, Rockrock, we're still far from talking about outcomes!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Now hurry up and walk faster. A stinking passageway like this isn't good for your wounded men's health.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Right, the air in the countryside should be better than inside Londinium.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Based on Rhodes Island's analysis, we should enter a branch of the Sarkaz's supply line up ahead.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: We're back.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Granny, what is the situation like?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: It's safe. We didn't run into any sentries, and there are no signs of patrols. It looks to be a maintenance access. There are some instruments there, although I have the faintest idea what they are for.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: But it's strange. We couldn't find where that real 'supply line' was.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Nonetheless, the access should be more than enough for an evacuation right now.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Now hurry up, boy. Have your little friends get off their arses. A moment of safety doesn't mean peace forever.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Okay. I got it.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: I'll take a look at the equipment we took. There might be something we can put to use. The crawlers that got written off might still be usable, if luck's on our side.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Granny!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: It's not that I don't believe in what we're doing, and I'm not losing heart over this setback.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We... We can come back, right?

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: What kind of answer do you want me to give you?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I've been cheering everyone up, but I've never really left this place myself.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: On top of that, we're leaving like this.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Feist, I used to think every so often that... we're actually pretty lucky.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: We were born in this city, we have trustworthy friends and jobs that are worth doing.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: And at the weekends, we can even head to the pubs in the alleys for a pint, play some cards, and maybe win some change.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Of course, Victoria has never been truly at peace.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: The things we make are sent to the border region to fight the Sargonians or the Leithanians and blast holes in their bodies—Not that it has anything to do with us.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: All we had to do was stay in the factory and turn screws on the iron blocks.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: We suffered pain too, and we had scars that would never heal... but we never had to worry about who to kill or we will be killed by tomorrow.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: At the very least, we could live, or at least pretend to.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: When the Sarkaz came, our lives got a little harder. When the factories were handed over, our lives got harder again.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: But the way I see it, I consider us still more or less lucky enough.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Just what is your definition of 'lucky enough?'

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Being able to stand here and talk about the past.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: But now our luck has come to an end. No one can keep winning the lottery forever.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: But so what? Most people aren't lucky at all, and they still manage to find themselves a way out.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Now go back to work, 'Big Deal in the Corps.' The chopper isn't going to pack itself up.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Do what you should do, just as you promised me back then.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Hm, now what did you say back then? 'I will walk into every night—'

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Enough, Granny! I was still...

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Regretting your lies now?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I will do it. I will still do it.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Times like these, you look just like Harvey.

Catherine looks at Feist with a sidelong glance before disappearing into the crowd. All around Feist, men dressed in all kinds of attire come and go. All of them are exhausted, but not a single one of them has given up.
Feist knows that all those who stand here are his most trustworthy allies.
This little comfort is better than nothing. As the idea crosses his mind, Feist breathes out a little and exercises his stiff arm after having been on edge for so long.
Once the mist fog that we call opportunities, luck, and other nouns disperses, what form will life take this time?
Feist decides to stop speculating and to instead experience it himself.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Feist—

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: The wounded are all in position. Now we just have to take the maintenance access and leave Londinium, and we'll be safe for the time being.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: We'll rebuild Squad 11 of the Self-Salvation Corps when that time comes, right?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Of course. I promise you.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Let's go.
Suddenly, Feist feels a faint tremor.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: What's... going on?
In the distance, the exit and entrance of this underground structure gradually begin to close at the same time.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Why is the passage getting sealed off? Did the Sarkaz find us?!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Damn it! Catherine and Clovisia are both over at the entrance!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: No, I've been listening in on the Sarkaz communication channels around us. We shouldn't be exposed.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Uh, it can't be a wiring problem, right?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: No, these passageways have manually controlled gates. I checked before entering, and I didn't see any problems with the drive system.
Feist has very good eyes, and he has always been very proud of this fact. This is pretty rare in the factories, where lighting is always needed for the workers to actually do anything.
Yet at this very moment, he would rather not have seen what he saw so clearly.
At the other end of the entrance, beyond the gap that is about to shut, he spots a few familiar silhouettes.
The silhouettes flash by until the gate closes completely and the last ray of light disappears behind its iron frame.
Until darkness engulfs all of them.
Feist tries his best to regain his footing. He feels the taste of blood spread throughout his mouth.
He tries to swallow this blood stench but finds himself unable to. He can't.

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: This isn't part of the plan!

steps.name: Closure
steps.text: Who's over there on that side of the passage? What are they trying to do?!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: What's the matter, Feist? Are... Are your lips bleeding...?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I know who it was on the other side.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: They.... They're my friends. The factory workers of Munitions Factory No. 11.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: They said they were going to check if there was any equipment left that we could take.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: They're the only ones who could've closed the gate.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: ...Tommy.

steps.name: Londinium Worker A
steps.text: Catherine, this... this wasn't my idea! We all decided this together!

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Just like when you saved me?

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: That's a whole separate thing, Catherine!

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: Tommy, get back to work. Find a Defense Forces soldier and tell him what happened here.

steps.name: Londinium Worker A
steps.text: A-Alright! I know where they are!

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: I have to say, your kidnapping skills are far worse than the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: I'm not trying to look for trouble with you, Catherine. How many years have we known each other? There's no surprises here.

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: But we don't want to die in the Londinium countryside, killed by those monsters' Arts either!

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: I'm just a foundry worker! I can use the furnace, the choppers, and I can cast some passable parts.

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: But now they want us to leave the city and fight a war with the dukes and the Sarkaz? You've got to be kidding. Out of all the things that I've ever held in my hands, the only thing that even remotely looks like weapon is my spanner!

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: Catherine, I promise. It'll all be fine. I have an uncle who's in the Defense Forces. I can talk to him, see if he can plead on the factory workers' behalf.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: What about the things we've done? We attacked the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: We can say that it was the Self-Salvation Corps who did it. We had no choice.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: Hah, and you think they'll believe you?

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: We may face harsher treatment after this... but as long as the dukes win this war, we can go back to our lives before!

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: We forged Londinium with our own hands!

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: Everything will get better.

steps.name: Catherine
steps.text: You didn't used to lick the nobles' boots like this.

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: What choice do I have, Catherine?! Tell me. What choice do I have?!

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: I... I just don't want to leave my home. I just want to walk on the streets of Londinium again, maybe play ball with my friends every now and then.

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: ...I don't want to die in a shell crater in the countryside, with my arms and legs all blown off. I've seen it before.

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: The Sarkaz... They will only get more and more brutal. My daughter might not even be able to put my dead body back together.

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: Go, Catherine. I don't want to be rough with you.

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: As for you, little leader of the resistance...

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: Hm? Where did she go?
There is only a rope that has been cut in the spot where Clovisia used to be.

steps.name: Londinium Worker C
steps.text: Huh? She was here just a minute ago! Where'd she...?

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: You mean to tell me you couldn't keep eyes on a little girl?

steps.name: Londinium Worker C
steps.text: I-It has to be some kind of Arts!

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: Whatever... Let her go. I heard she's just the daughter of a tailor.

steps.name: Londinium Worker B
steps.text: I just hope that she'll find a hiding place in Londinium's dark night.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: ...It stinks.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: How many people do you think have died the last couple days?

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Don't take the alley to the north. A few Infected went kaboom there yesterday. There's Originium dust everywhere.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Those Sarkaz bastards! Their plan was always to trap us in here and have us fend for ourselves!

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: You went to the transport union during the day. What did Marshall say?

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: The place got burned down. There are nothing but steel beams left. I don't know if Marshall was in the pile of dead bodies. I didn't try to look.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Porties can't all be idiots and wimps, right?

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: All this is... is us taking a punch directly, and we're still dazed.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Once we come round, Norport Borough will bounce back!

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Perhaps the dukes will make it here soon. When the time comes...

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: What? When did you start worshipping the dukes? Are you hiding the Duke of Wellington's bloody autograph in your drawer now or something?

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: We have to count on ourselves!

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: We can leave this place. I will lead the charge, I swear!

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: The last time you swore anything, you told me you would never fall asleep while you stood night watch.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: I was just...!

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Enough. Before we start dreaming, we have to find ourselves something to eat.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: We have Delphine and her tendency to hoard to thank for keeping the gym's storerooms well stocked.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Otherwise, we would likely be in this pile of dead bodies, too.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: Cador, they're fighting up ahead again.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Ugh, not here too...

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Let's take another route. The restaurants at the loading area might still have some supplies.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: We could try to buy something... or trade.

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: What will you do if they don't want to sell?

steps.name: Baird
steps.text: You brought a weapon.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: This is just for defense. We won't use it.

steps.name: Cador
steps.text: Things... have yet to get that bad.
